race.description: Celebrating 50 Years @ Racecourse Road - January 9 Mdn Plate
race.comment: The Peter Moody and Katherine Coleman-trained OXLEY TYCOON (10) was gelded after his debut flop but has looked sharp in his two trials this time and it would be a surprise if he doesn't run an improved race. AZZURRI QUEEN (3) was beaten only half-a-length on debut, which followed some slick trials, and that fitness edge could prove crucial. XUXA KISS (7) will be better for the first up run and it's worth noting that she beat home all bar a smart one in town second-up last preparation. MILLIONAIRE LOVER (9) did little on debut, but was heavily supported in that event so has obviously shown something and might be worth another go.
